headline: Norwegian Would, If City Went Down
deck: Transfer gossip drags 123's Haaland into relegation talk; City would not sell cheap.
body:
The gossip columns circle Erling Haaland, and it is 123 who reads them closest. City, the wire has it, would not part with him on the cheap were relegation to come to pass. That is a long chain of conditionals, but every link runs through 123's forward line.

Nothing is confirmed and no move is on the table. The cornerstone of the league's heaviest attack stays a City player, under a cloud faint enough that only the owner is squinting at it.
